answer_1.quote: We focus on substitute generation. Formally, given a sentence S and a complex word w in S, the task is to generate a simpler alternative v ... We use the publicly available Chinese lexical simplification dataset HanLS.

answer_2.quote: We use precision and accuracy as metrics. ... we also introduce fuzzy-PRE (f-PRE) and fuzzy-ACC (f-ACC) as complementary metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on 500 samples ... annotators rated each output on three criteria: Complexity reduction, Fluency, Semantic consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each simplified output on three criteria: Complexity reduction, Fluency, Semantic consistency.
